name: Yukinoshita Hotaru no Koharubiyori ~Onee-chan to no Himitsu Dousei~
original_name: 幸乃下蛍の恋青日和 ～お義姉ちゃんとの秘密同棲～
source:
This spring, at the local prep school Seiyou Academy, where the protagonist (nameable) attends. He has something that he cannot share with anyone, a secret.

"Today is a good day for the entrance ceremony, to all new students. Congratulations on your admissions."
"On behalf of the current students, I sincerely welcome you."

Smiling on the podium, the student council president Yukinoshita Hotaru, due to the recent remarriage of their parents, she has become the protagonist's step-sister.

A person he admires, since he has feelings for her, he keeps his distance. Because his sister thinks that he is adorable and likes him, she is unable to get closer to him.

The turning point of their relationship comes, when suddenly, their parents decide to go on a trip. Naturally, the protagonist and his sister are left to take care of the house. Whether they like it or not, their feelings risen.

A secret cohabitation life, now, it begins!

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.willplus-japan.com/tokohana/product/koharubiyori/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
这个春天，主角（名字可自定）在当地的升学学校清阳学园就读。他心里藏着一件不能对任何人说的秘密。

“今天风和日丽，正是举办入学典礼的好日子。恭喜各位新生入学。”
“我谨代表全体在校生，衷心欢迎大家的到来。”

在台上微笑致辞的学生会长幸乃下萤，因双方父母不久前再婚，成了主角的继姐。

他一直仰慕她，正因为喜欢，才刻意拉开距离。姐姐也觉得他可爱，喜欢着他，却同样没办法再靠近一步。

两人关系的转机，来自父母突然决定出门旅行。看家的差事自然落到了姐弟头上。不论两人愿不愿意，那份感情都在升温。

无人知晓的同居生活，现在开始！
